title: Quiet Resolution
description:
A simulated packet capture contains this DNS exchange from the fictional `rabbit.lab` network:

```
12:04:01.221 10.20.0.15:53211 -> 10.20.0.2:53
  Query: A updates.rabbit.lab
12:04:01.229 10.20.0.2:53 -> 10.20.0.15:53211
  Answer: A 10.20.0.44 (TTL 300)
```

The instructor asks which fully qualified domain name was resolved.
objective: Submit the resolved domain name as HC{domain}.

hints.text: DNS queries ask for a name and receive an address.
